reviews.text: The BEST of the BEST! So much love goes into their work, my dogs are actually EXCITED to go!

The last time i took my dog here, they cut my dog’s ear and gave him a hematoma!!! Amd tried to bandage it as if it’s no big deal and giving him an ugly furcut. Moving on and never coming back. Plus the owner was asking for donations from his own customers for a personal situation that’s going on with his tenants.  Who does that?
Every visit has been wonderful — these professionals always do a supurb job. I wholeheartedly recommend their dog grooming services.

What can I say?  It is extremely hard to find a patient and kind establishment that will have passion for our furbabies.  Animals get so stressed either at the Vet office or the groomer but somehow, going to Buds N' Suds is like a Godsend.  Issac is OMG one of the most caring and passionate groomers I am blessed to know.  Throughout the years he has had the ultimate passion for his craft, has build what I will called an empire because this has been his dream and buds n' suds is his baby and he raises the bar high on his quality and truthfully, issac would not have it any other way.  I can clearly place my trust with him because he provides the best quality service.  If you are looking for a groomer with a huge heart and passion, look no further, Issac will take Super Excellent care of you and I assure you, you will be satisfied and your furbaby will look FABULOUS!  Thank you Issac for your passion for our animals, you are truly an inspiration.  I wish many more would possess your qualities.  YOU ARE THE BEST!  Jessie Santiago

Four years later and my partner and I are happy as ever with Buds N’ Suds! Isaac and his team are phenomenal. When we first started going to Buds N’ Suds, we had our little chi-weenie guy, Grizzly Bear, who tends to be a bit anxious due to unpleasant experience elsewhere as a puppy, but Isaac has always been and is very kind and patient with my boy. Eventually, we adopted a sweet but nutty little snorkie mix named Archie and began taking him to Buds N’ Suds as well. Despite Archie being far from easy in the beginning, Isaac and his team worked their magic on him, too, and he’s gotten much better. While I have a laundry list of reasons why I take my little ones to Buds N’ Suds, my top reasons are that Isaac and his team are very patient with my boys and the other animals in their care (I’ve seen it myself), passionate about what they do, and detail-oriented in their work and it shows. Thank you, Buds N’ Suds team, for all that you do!!

Just took my adorable pup to Buds N Suds dog grooming place and I'm beyond impressed! The staff were super friendly and really took care of my furry friend. The grooming services were top-notch and my dog looks and smells amazing! Highly recommend for any pet owner in the area. Five stars isn't enough - I'd give 'em ten stars if I could!!
Amazing groomers always ready to take care of my pup.
Super friendly and easy to communicate with. Great work, making the doggies look and feel good.
They typically do a decent job, but one of their groomers cut our dog badly and when we reached out to the owner about it, he never returned our call regarding it.
They made my baby look and smell so good!! Very friendly staff as well!! 💙 …

I'm going back to change my 5 stars to 1 star. I've called several times to make another appointment but no one ever answers the phone or text messages. My wife found a news article floating around on social media saying that the owner of buds n suds is being sued and the shop might be closing down soon due to the lawsuit. If this is the case the owner of the company should at least let clients know what's going on so we can find a new groomer. This is highly unprofessional and I truly recommend everyone find a new groomer.
I’ve been searching for a good grooming salon for my cavapoo, Oliver, and I’m thrilled to have finally found one!

I just moved to Chicago and was looking for a place to groom my mini poodle and a friend recommended Buds n Suds. Very pleased with the customer service and how lovely my little poodle turned out. Thank you for a great experience! Will definitely be coming back.
